lines.zh: 我摆两下尾巴就窜出一格。
lines.en: Two flicks of my tail and I am a block away.

lines.zh: 五条并排游，水面被我们划开。
lines.en: Five of us abreast, splitting the surface.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底的沙，找碎屑吃。
lines.en: I skim the sandy bottom, hunting scraps.

lines.zh: 银色的背一晃，你就找不着我了。
lines.en: One flash of my silver back and I am gone.

lines.zh: 我游得碎，方向一秒换三次。
lines.en: My path is jerky, changing course three times a second.

lines.zh: 浅水里我最快，深了就不行了。
lines.en: I am swiftest in shallows, slower in the deep.

lines.zh: 整群一起转弯，水响成一片。
lines.en: The whole school turns and the water rustles.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子底下溜过去。
lines.en: I slip underneath your shadow.

lines.zh: 我个头小，一条缝就够我过。
lines.en: I am small; a single gap is enough to pass.

lines.zh: 水草边上有吃的，我去看看。
lines.en: There is food by the weeds; let me check.

lines.zh: 我绕着石头转了一圈，又转一圈。
lines.en: I circle the stone once, then once more.

lines.zh: 别的鱼一靠近，我就散开。
lines.en: When another fish nears, we scatter.

lines.zh: 我游得很浅，背鳍擦着水面。
lines.en: I swim so shallow my fin grazes the surface.

lines.zh: 哪里有水，哪里就有我们这一群。
lines.en: Wherever there is water, my school is there.

lines.zh: 我抢到你脚边，捡面包屑。
lines.en: I dart to your feet for bread crumbs.

lines.zh: 水一凉，整群就往深处沉。
lines.en: The water cools and the whole school sinks deeper.

lines.zh: 我撞上同伴，又各自散开。
lines.en: I bump a schoolmate, then we scatter apart.

lines.zh: 从水面看，我们像一片碎银。
lines.en: From above we look like a patch of broken silver.

lines.zh: 我停在水草里，只动鳃。
lines.en: I rest in the weeds, moving only my gills.

lines.zh: 五条挤在石缝里，谁也不想出去。
lines.en: Five of us crowd a crevice, none willing to leave.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃，我跟着晃。
lines.en: Light wobbles on the surface and I wobble with it.

lines.zh: 我嘴里嚼着一小片藻。
lines.en: I chew a small scrap of algae.

lines.zh: 我悬在中间，头朝水流来的方向。
lines.en: I hover facing the current, head upstream.

lines.zh: 一条同伴碰我，我让开半寸。
lines.en: A companion nudges me and I yield half an inch.

lines.zh: 水底安静，我听见远处的桨声。
lines.en: The bottom is quiet; I hear distant oars.

lines.zh: 我肚子上有一点白，正好反光。
lines.en: My belly is white and catches the light.

lines.zh: 群散了又聚，聚了又散。
lines.en: The school scatters and gathers, scatters and gathers.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等水流送来东西。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open for the current to feed me.

lines.zh: 石头下的阴凉处，我待得住。
lines.en: I can stay in the shade beneath this stone.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下尾，其实没什么事。
lines.en: I flick my tail for no reason at all.

lines.zh: 眼睛两侧各一只，前后都能看见。
lines.en: An eye on each side, I see front and back.

lines.zh: 一天到晚，水里都是同一种安静。
lines.en: All day the water keeps the same quiet.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水里晃，我啄了一下。
lines.en: Your face wavers in the water; I peck at it.

lines.zh: 我游到你手边，又退开半格。
lines.en: I swim to your hand, then retreat half a block.

lines.zh: 你的影子太大，我绕开它。
lines.en: Your shadow is too large; I go around it.

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，我五条一起散。
lines.en: You reach in and all five of us scatter.

lines.zh: 我在水里看你，你在我眼里是倒的。
lines.en: I look up at you, upside down from here.

lines.zh: 你不像鱼，可你总盯着水。
lines.en: You are no fish, yet you keep staring at water.

lines.zh: 我停在你的倒影上，像停在一片云上。
lines.en: I rest on your reflection like a patch of cloud.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的工夫，我已经换了地方。
lines.en: In the time you blink, I have moved.

lines.zh: 我探出水面看一眼，又沉回去。
lines.en: I poke above the surface, look, and sink back.

lines.zh: 你走一步，水就震一下。
lines.en: Each of your steps shakes the water.

lines.zh: 你一巴掌把我打进沙里。
lines.en: One slap drives me into the sand.

lines.zh: 我翻了个白肚，又硬撑过来。
lines.en: I flip belly-up, then right myself.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，味道很重。
lines.en: My blood clouds the water with a heavy smell.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼一下全跑了。
lines.en: Every fish in the school bolts at once.

lines.zh: 我掉在岸上，蹦了两下。
lines.en: I land on the bank and flop twice.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你下手也太重。
lines.en: I am this small; your swing was excessive.

lines.zh: 我掉出几粒骨粉，你别嫌弃。
lines.en: A few bone meal grains drop from me; take them.

lines.zh: 三条生命，一下就去了一半。
lines.en: Three points of life, and half is gone.

lines.zh: 我游不动了，只能顺水漂。
lines.en: I cannot swim, so I drift with the current.

lines.zh: 我倒下时，水里多了一点白。
lines.en: When I fall, a little white is left in the water.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎饵，我第一个冲过去。
lines.en: You scatter crumbs and I reach them first.

lines.zh: 有面包屑，整群都朝那边挤。
lines.en: Bread crumbs! The whole school crowds that way.

lines.zh: 那点味道顺着水来，我甩尾就追。
lines.en: That scent rides the current; one flick and I chase.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在动，我就跟着动。
lines.en: The thing in your hand moves, so I move.

lines.zh: 五条里我最贪，先咬一口试试。
lines.en: Of the five, I am greediest; I bite first.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子像虫子，我扑了一下。
lines.en: A shadow looks like a bug; I lunge at it.

lines.zh: 我闻到一股腥味，鳍都竖起来了。
lines.en: A fishy smell hits me and my fins stand up.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转，先看有没有钩。
lines.en: I circle the bait first, checking for a hook.

lines.zh: 别抖手，抖一下我就跑了。
lines.en: Do not jitter; one twitch and I bolt.

lines.zh: 你给的东西小，我还是要抢。
lines.en: What you offer is tiny, and still I fight for it.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，弹开一小段。
lines.en: I hit your leg and bounce a short way off.

lines.zh: 五条挤在一起，撞得水花四溅。
lines.en: Five of us bunch and knock up a splash.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子撞到石头，有点麻。
lines.en: My snout hits stone and tingles.

lines.zh: 你的脚一挪，我差点被压住。
lines.en: Your foot shifts and I nearly get pinned.

lines.zh: 我太小，撞你也不痛不痒。
lines.en: I am too small to hurt you by bumping.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼撞我，我顺势转个弯。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps me and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 水面被我撞出一圈小涟漪。
lines.en: My bump raises a small ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 我被你的靴子推得倒退两格。
lines.en: Your boot shoves me back two blocks.

lines.zh: 撞完我就跑，没打算道歉。
lines.en: I flee after the bump, with no apology.

lines.zh: 石头缝太窄，我卡了一下。
lines.en: The crevice is too narrow; I wedge for a moment.

lines.zh: 五条挤成一群，其实是一家人。
lines.en: The five of us crowd together as one family.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，尾巴拍得很急。
lines.en: I circle my mate, tail beating quickly.

lines.zh: 我们把卵粘在水草背面。
lines.en: We stick our eggs to the underside of weeds.

lines.zh: 它银色更亮，我跟着它游。
lines.en: Its silver shines brighter; I follow it.

lines.zh: 两条并排，转向总是同时。
lines.en: Side by side, we always turn at the same moment.

lines.zh: 群里的位置，我排在它后面。
lines.en: In the school's order, I swim behind it.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被我们扇出一个小坑。
lines.en: Our fins fan a small pit in the sand.

lines.zh: 这一季水里会有很多小鱼。
lines.en: This season the water will hold many small fish.

lines.zh: 它碰我一下，我就懂了。
lines.en: It bumps me once and I understand.

lines.zh: 我们不分谁先谁后，一起走。
lines.en: Neither leads nor follows; we simply move.

lines.zh: 那么小的东西，我叼不住。
lines.en: Something that size will not stay in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推，它就沉了。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth and it sinks.

lines.zh: 群鱼抢一块东西，转眼就没了。
lines.en: The school fights over a scrap and it is gone.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，发现不是吃的。
lines.en: I bite it and find it is not food.

lines.zh: 它比我还重，我根本拖不动。
lines.en: It outweighs me; I cannot drag it at all.

lines.zh: 那东西掉进水里，我绕着看。
lines.en: It fell in the water; I circle and stare.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞不下，只好吐出来。
lines.en: It will not fit in my mouth, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 五条一起顶，才把它挪了半格。
lines.en: Five of us push, and it shifts half a block.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，可我还是抢。
lines.en: I do not need it, and still I snatch it.

lines.zh: 它卡在水草里，我钻进去找。
lines.en: It is caught in the weeds; I wriggle in after it.

lines.zh: 有东西落水，声响把我引过去。
lines.en: Something hits the water and the sound draws me.

lines.zh: 水里抖了一下，我转头去看。
lines.en: The water twitches and I turn to look.

lines.zh: 那团影子小，大概能吃。
lines.en: That shadow is small, probably edible.

lines.zh: 我闻到血味，整群都躁起来。
lines.en: I smell blood and the whole school grows restless.

lines.zh: 你动了一下手指，我看见了。
lines.en: You move a finger and I notice.

lines.zh: 水草那边有动静，我先靠过去。
lines.en: Something stirs by the weeds; I approach first.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那点银色，不是同伴。
lines.en: I fix on that silver, and it is no schoolmate.

lines.zh: 有东西在挣扎，水波乱得很。
lines.en: Something struggles and the ripples go wild.

lines.zh: 我不大，可我冲得很快。
lines.en: I am not big, but I charge fast.

lines.zh: 目标就在前面，我先绕一圈。
lines.en: The target lies ahead; I circle it once first.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，尾巴绷得很紧。
lines.en: I stare at you, my tail pulled taut.

lines.zh: 你动，我跟着动，差半格。
lines.en: You move, I move, half a block behind.

lines.zh: 整群都朝你那侧偏了。
lines.en: The whole school has leaned your way.

lines.zh: 我绕到你下游，顺着水看你。
lines.en: I circle downstream to watch you with the current.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，我们就围上来。
lines.en: You step into the water and we close in.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，随时能窜出去。
lines.en: I hug the surface, ready to dart.

lines.zh: 你退，我不追远，只跟三步。
lines.en: You retreat; I follow three steps, no more.

lines.zh: 那点动静一直没停，我不走。
lines.en: The disturbance has not stopped; I stay.

lines.zh: 我挑了你脚踝那一侧。
lines.en: I have chosen the side by your ankle.

lines.zh: 你还没发现，我已经在你脚边了。
lines.en: You have not noticed; I am already at your feet.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝，其实咬不动。
lines.en: I bite your ankle and barely dent it.

lines.zh: 五条一起撞，像下了一阵小鱼雨。
lines.en: Five of us ram you like a rain of small fish.

lines.zh: 我的牙细，只能留下一点红。
lines.en: My teeth are fine and leave only a pink mark.

lines.zh: 你挥手赶我，我从指缝钻过去。
lines.en: You swat at me; I slip between your fingers.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你手背上，弹开。
lines.en: I butt your hand and bounce away.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，尝到的全是盐。
lines.en: I bite and taste nothing but salt.

lines.zh: 群鱼围着你转，你分不清哪条是我。
lines.en: The school whirls around you; you cannot tell which is me.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，但我来了很多次。
lines.en: Each hit is light, but I come many times.

lines.zh: 你不理我，我就再咬一口。
lines.en: You ignore me, so I bite once more.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我从不单独来。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I never come alone.

lines.zh: 任何一片水里都能生出我。
lines.en: Any stretch of water can spawn me.

lines.zh: 这次的群有五个，我最小。
lines.en: This school numbers five, and I am the smallest.

lines.zh: 我出现得最多，水里到处是同类。
lines.en: I appear most often; my kind fills every pond.

lines.zh: 一滴水里就有我的位置。
lines.en: Even a drop of water has room for me.

lines.zh: 我从浅水冒出来，先找同伴。
lines.en: I surface in the shallows and look for company.

lines.zh: 群生群死，我们从不单独行动。
lines.en: We school in life and death, never alone.

lines.zh: 生成的地方没有讲究，有水就行。
lines.en: I am picky about nothing but water.

lines.zh: 三条生命，够我活过这个下午。
lines.en: Three points of life will last me this afternoon.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，身边已经挤了四条。
lines.en: I open my eyes to four already crowding me.

lines.zh: 水面动了一下，我就这样来了。
lines.en: The surface stirred, and that is how I came.

lines.zh: 火舔到我，水面都冒了热气。
lines.en: Fire licks me and the water steams.

lines.zh: 从水面摔到岸上，我弹了三下。
lines.en: Falling from water onto land, I bounce three times.

lines.zh: 我在水里生，也在水里喘。
lines.en: I am born in water and breathe it too.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我跟着翻了出去。
lines.en: The blast opens the water and flings me out.

lines.zh: 箭射穿我，把我钉在沙上。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and pins me to sand.

lines.zh: 魔法打在水里，我整群都麻了。
lines.en: Magic strikes the water and the school goes numb.

lines.zh: 碎屑吃不到，我瘦得只剩一条线。
lines.en: With no scraps, I thin down to a line.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我翻着白肚浮上来。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and I float up belly-first.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我连摆尾都难。
lines.en: No water in the void, so I can hardly swim.
